goalsSummary: Local-first PWA for discipleship spaces: Bible reading (public-domain KJV/WEB), sessions, invites, and optional light room relay — data stays on-device by default.
assetsSummary:
• Brand: DiscipleSpaces cross icons + favicon (public/icons)
• Bible data: public/data/bible (KJV/WEB)
• Deploy: Cloudflare Pages disciple-spaces + optional space-relay Worker
• Production: https://disciple-spaces.pages.dev

confirmations.text: Preview/production on Cloudflare Pages (disciple-spaces.pages.dev) is the current public app shell. Correct?
User spaces/sessions stay in IndexedDB on-device; optional relay is only for short join codes when configured. Still correct?
Bible text is public-domain KJV + WEB only (no paid translations). Still correct?
Custom domain can become canonical later (VITE_CANONICAL_ORIGIN); migrate users with Back up → Restore. Still correct?

notesForOperator: First-party studio product (not client MediaLaunch site). Prefer build-state + this facts file for Hub. Stack details stay in build-state, not here.
